coverage.headline: Idaho Men's Basketball Tops Northern Colorado 72-65 Behind Strong Second Half
coverage.recap:
Idaho defeated Northern Colorado 72-65 Wednesday night at the Cowan Spectrum, using a dominant second-half performance to pull away and secure a conference victory.

The Vandals built their advantage on the glass and at the charity stripe, outrebounding the Bears 38-31 and converting 12 of 15 free throw attempts. Idaho committed just nine turnovers to Northern Colorado's 15, a margin that created a steady stream of extra possessions and proved decisive in a game ultimately decided by seven points.

Idaho shot 26 of 58 from the field and connected on 8 of 22 attempts from three-point range. Northern Colorado stayed within reach by shooting 24 of 54 from the floor and converting 6 of 18 from beyond the arc, but the Bears could not match the Vandals' efficiency in the paint or close out the possession disadvantage created by 15 turnovers.

The Vandals distributed the ball effectively, finishing with 14 assists against Northern Colorado's 11. Idaho's ball movement generated open looks from the perimeter and helped the Vandals maintain separation after taking control in the second half. Northern Colorado made a push during a late stretch, but Idaho's defense stiffened and the Vandals executed down the stretch to preserve the margin.

The seven-point final score reflected a game that was tighter at times than the outcome indicates. Idaho made the necessary plays when it mattered most, limiting its own mistakes while forcing Northern Colorado into difficult situations on both ends of the floor. The victory keeps the Vandals well-positioned in the conference standings heading into the next home game.
coverage.spotlight_body: Smith led all scorers with 22 points on 8-of-14 shooting, adding seven rebounds and five assists. His three-point shooting — 4-of-7 from deep — helped Idaho stretch Northern Colorado's defense throughout the contest.
coverage.social_post: Idaho 72, Northern Colorado 65. The Vandals outrebounded the Bears 38-31 and held UNC to 15 turnovers in a conference win. #GoVandals
